requirement.description: Missing parameter values cause RuntimeError when parameters are not provided with values in function calls. The code attempts to extract parameter values but doesn't properly handle cases where parameters are missing or have no default values.
requirement.contract: When a parameter is not provided with a value in template_inputs, the runner should either use a default value if one is defined or provide a clearer error message indicating which parameter is missing, rather than throwing a generic RuntimeError.

requirement.description: Directory creation errors occur when attempting to write output files to paths that are directories instead of files. This happens when the outputs directory path is incorrectly configured or when the system tries to treat a directory as a file.
requirement.contract: When writing output files, the runner should detect if the target path is a directory and create an appropriate file inside that directory instead of failing with an IsADirectoryError.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_with_result[pydantic output with result output-1] tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_with_result[pydantic output with result output-2]

requirement.description: Artifact loading fails when artifacts are not properly configured or when artifact paths are invalid. The code raises a RuntimeError with unclear information about which artifact failed to load.
requirement.contract: When an artifact is not properly configured or its path is invalid, the runner should provide clearer error messages that identify the specific artifact that failed to load.

requirement.description: Parameter name mapping between kebab-case and snake_case is incomplete. Some parameter names are not properly converted, causing missing parameter errors.
requirement.contract: Parameter name mapping should properly handle conversion between kebab-case (e.g., "a-but-kebab") and snake_case (e.g., "a_but_kebab") to ensure all parameters are correctly matched.

requirement.description: Pydantic validation errors occur when loading parameters with non-base model classes that lack proper validation configurations. These errors are not being caught or handled gracefully.
requirement.contract: When loading parameters with non-base model classes, the runner should properly handle Pydantic validation errors and provide clear error messages indicating which parameter failed validation.
